title: 's-Gravenhoek
text:
's-Gravenhoek
's-Gravenhoek
'
s-Gravenhoek
is a former municipality in the
Dutch
province of
Zeeland
. It consisted of a number of polders on the north side of the island of
Noord-Beveland
, east of
Wissenkerke
.
The municipality of 's-Gravenhoek was smaller than the former domain (
heerlijkheid
) of the same name, which included the two polders Oud-'s-Gravenhoek and Nieuw-'s-Gravenhoek, which flooded in 1745 and 1752.
[
1
]
The remaining part of the municipality had a low population, as it contained no village or hamlet, and it merged with neighbouring
Wissenkerke
in 1816.

2
]
